plan: Deep-copy the authored recipe, resolve substitutions recursively, then scale once to the target yield.
Collect all unresolved exclusions, cycles, and unavailable equipment before deciding whether adaptation is possible.
mechanisms: Queued chained substitutions for replacements and additional ingredients
Global instruction, preparation, and equipment rewrites
Cycle ancestry tracking and aggregate reason collection
Immutable original preservation through deep copying

trace.target_mechanism: Deep-copy adaptation and direct authored_text printing preserve the original recipe.
Candidates are ordered by numeric priority and then catalog position.
Replacement and additional ingredients are returned to the adaptation queue.
Chosen name and wording changes are applied globally in selection order.
Each choice updates ingredient fields, wording, equipment, and effective yield together.
Introduced ingredients are checked recursively and final equipment is validated.
Final quantities are scaled exactly using Fraction-compatible arithmetic.
